items.title: What’s new in AWS Transform – continuous modernization for re:Invent 2026
items.summary: Ahead of re:Invent 2026, AWS Transform continuous modernization is faster to start, easier to act on, and easier to extend. A new AWS Health integration takes you from a planned lifecycle event straight to the affected code, and remediations now arrive as one clean pull request per repository.
items.creator: Nithin Moorthy
